application.Auto signin - Tooltip: When a logged-in session exists in Casdoor, it is automatically used for application-side login
application.Backchannel logout URL - Tooltip: The endpoint where Casdoor sends an OIDC Back-Channel Logout token (a signed JWT) when the user logs out, so the application can terminate the corresponding session. Leave empty to disable back-channel logout for this application
application.Background URL - Tooltip: URL of the background image used in the login page
application.Background URL Mobile - Tooltip: URL of the background image used in the login page (mobile)
application.Client cert - Tooltip: Client certificate used for mutual TLS authentication between the client and server
application.Code resend timeout - Tooltip: Time period (in seconds) that users must wait before requesting another verification code. Set to 0 to use the global default (60 seconds)
application.Cookie expire - Tooltip: Session cookie expiration time; determines how long the user's session remains valid after login

application.Custom CSS Mobile - Tooltip: Registration, login, and password-reset form styles (border and shadow) for mobile
application.Default tag - Tooltip: Tag given to users who sign up through this application without a tag of their own

Use the client's picker to find the window and the controls.
application.Disable SAML attributes - Tooltip: Whether to disable including attribute statements in SAML assertion responses
application.Disable refresh token rotation - Tooltip: A refresh returns the same refresh token instead of a new one, and the access tokens of earlier refreshes stay valid until they expire. Turn it on when several processes share one refresh token, e.g. the parallel jobs of a CLI. Less secure: a leaked refresh token works until it expires, so keep its expiry short
application.Disable self signup - Tooltip: Users can no longer sign themselves up on the signup page, by magic link or by verification code, only with an invitation code. Signing up with the application's providers, e.g. the first SSO login of a new employee, still works
application.Discovered from the issuer if empty: Discovered from the issuer if empty
application.Enable Email linking - Tooltip: When using 3rd-party providers to log in, if there is a user in the organization with the same Email, the 3rd-party login method will be automatically associated with that user
application.Enable SAML C14N10 - Tooltip: Use C14N10 instead of C14N11 in SAML
application.Enable SAML POST binding - Tooltip: The HTTP POST binding uses input fields in a HTML form to send SAML messages, Enable when your SP use it
application.Enable SAML assertion signature - Toolti: Whether to digitally sign the SAML assertion in addition to the SAML response
application.Enable SAML compression - Tooltip: Whether to compress SAML response messages when Casdoor is used as SAML idp
application.Enable custom scripts - Tooltip: Render the custom HTML of this application as it is on the sign-in pages, scripts included, instead of removing its scripts. Only a global admin can turn it on, and change the custom HTML while it is on
application.Enable exclusive signin - Tooltip: When exclusive signin enabled, user cannot have multiple active session
application.Enable form autofill - Tooltip: Needs a Casdoor Enterprise edition license
application.Enable guest signin - Tooltip: Allow users to sign in as a guest without creating or logging into an account
application.Enable signup - Tooltip: Whether to allow users to register a new account
application.External groups - Tooltip: Groups of other organizations whose direct members can sign in to this application, in the format of "organization/group"
application.External users - Tooltip: Users of other organizations who can sign in to this application with their own accounts, in the format of "organization/username", they can also enter "organization/username" on the sign-in page
application.Failed signin frozen time - Tooltip: Waiting time after exceeding the number of failed login attempts. Users can only log in again after the waiting time expires. Default value is 15 minutes. The set value must be a positive integer
application.Failed signin limit - Tooltip: Maximum number of failed login attempts allowed in a short period. After exceeding the limit, login will be prohibited for a period of time. Default value is 5. The set value must be a positive integer
application.Federated credentials - Tooltip: Trust the tokens of external OIDC issuers (GitHub Actions, Kubernetes, cloud workloads, another IdP) as a credential of this application, verified with the issuer's JWKS. A matching token works as client_assertion, as the assertion of the JWT Bearer grant, or as the subject_token of Token Exchange, without a client secret. Subject supports the * wildcard. Audience defaults to the origin of Casdoor, its token endpoint, or the client ID. User is the user the token stands for, or {claim} to take it from a claim such as {email}
application.Fill in the information below to continu: Fill in the information below to continue
application.Footer HTML - Tooltip: Custom the footer of your application
application.Form autofill - Description: For legacy systems without SSO: once users install the Casdoor browser extension and sign in to Casdoor, the extension fills their managed account of this application into the sign-in pages below. Managed accounts are set on the user's page, or saved by users when they sign in by hand; their passwords can be encrypted in the organization's compliance settings.
application.Form position - Tooltip: Location of the signup, signin and forget password forms
application.Grant types - Tooltip: Select which grant types are allowed in the OAuth protocol
application.Header HTML - Tooltip: Custom the head tag of your application entry page
application.Import JSON - description: Import application settings from a JSON file exported from another Casdoor application
application.Key sequence - Tooltip: For the programs whose controls can't be seen, like self-drawn ones: typed into the focused window, with {username}, {password}, {TAB}, {ENTER} and {WAIT} (half a second). Default {username}{TAB}{password}
application.Launch arguments - Tooltip: For the programs that take the account in their command line, like PuTTY's -l {username} -pw {password}. Other processes of the same user can read a command line
application.Launch path - Tooltip: The full path that the client starts the program with from its menu, the program can't be started from the client when empty
application.Let users save their accounts - Tooltip: Users without a managed account of this system sign in by hand once, and the extension offers to save that account for the next time
application.MFA remember time - Tooltip: Configures the duration that a account is remembered as trusted after a successful MFA login
application.Menu mode - Tooltip: The display mode of the application navigation menu (e.g., inline, side panel, or top bar)
application.Never used, an earlier row already carri: Never used, an earlier row already carries this rule
application.No sign-in method is enabled, users will: No sign-in method is enabled, users will have no way to sign in. Enable one in Signin methods, or turn on Can signin for a provider.
application.Order - Tooltip: The smaller the value, the higher it ranks in the Apps page
application.Org choice mode - Tooltip: Method used to select the organization to log in
application.Other domains - Tooltip: Additional allowed domains for this application, used for cross-domain access control
application.Page HTML - Tooltip: Custom HTML for the application's main page, allowing complete control over the page structure and content
application.Password field selector - Tooltip: CSS selector of the password input, e.g. input[name=pwd]. Leave it empty to find it automatically
application.Please enable \"Signin session\" first b: Please enable "Signin session" first before enabling "Auto signin"
application.Program - Tooltip: The executable: a file name like u8client.exe, or a full path where * matches anything, like C:\Program Files\UFIDA\*\u8client.exe

application.Redirect URLs - Tooltip: Allowed redirect URL list, supporting regular expression matching; URLs not in the list will fail to redirect

application.SAML NameID template - Tooltip: Custom NameID value. application.Side panel HTML - Tooltip: Customize the HTML code for the side panel of the login page

application.Signup items - Tooltip: Items for users to fill in when registering new accounts
application.Submit automatically - Tooltip: Click the sign-in button after filling the form. When off, users click it themselves
application.Submit button selector - Tooltip: CSS selector of the sign-in button. Leave it empty to find it automatically, or to press Enter in the password input when there is none
application.The application does not allow to sign u: The application does not allow to sign up new account
application.Token cert - Tooltip: Certificate used for signing and verifying access tokens; must match the selected token signing method
application.Token fields - Tooltip: The user fields included in the token
application.Token signing method - Tooltip: Signing method of JWT token, needs to be the same algorithm as the certificate
application.Upstream host - Tooltip: The upstream backend host address when Casdoor is used in reverse proxy mode
application.Username control - Tooltip: Like id=txtUser, name=User name;type=Edit or type=Edit;index=0 (id is the automation ID, index counts from 0 among the matches), found automatically when empty
application.Username field selector - Tooltip: CSS selector of the username input, e.g. #username. Leave it empty to find it automatically

edition.Attribute-based access control - Descrip: Write matchers that decide by the attributes of the user, the resource and the request.
edition.Automatic rotation and expiry alerts - D: Rotate signing keys before they expire, or only get an alert.
edition.CEF and LEEF log forwarding - Descriptio: Forward audit logs in CEF or LEEF to SIEM and situational awareness platforms, set on a Syslog audit provider.
edition.Commercial - Summary: For teams running Casdoor in production: session control, password and attack defense, personal information protection, key rotation, RBAC and ABAC, the MCP gateway and paid integrations, with business-hours support.
edition.Consent records - Description: Each consent and revocation of a user to an application is kept with its time, scopes and IP.
edition.Credential stuffing defense - Descriptio: An IP that fails on too many accounts within 10 minutes is blocked for a while.
edition.Data export and account deletion - Descr: Users export their personal data and delete their accounts themselves.
edition.Disable inactive accounts - Description: Accounts that haven't signed in for the set number of days are disabled automatically, admins excepted.
edition.Enterprise - Summary: For government, finance, education and large organizations that need MLPS and cryptography compliance: Chinese SM algorithms, three-admin separation, tamper-proof audit records, separation of duties, compliance reports and enterprise connections, with 24/7 dedicated support.
edition.Exclusive sign-in - Description: Signing in on a new device signs the account out everywhere else, per application or across the organization.
edition.Government and office sign-in - Descript: Sign in with Zhezhengding and Yunzhijia, and connect Seeyon A8.
edition.HR system sync - Description: Sync employees and departments from Beisen, Moka and Yonyou HR with Marketplace plugins.
edition.Hardware OTP tokens - Description: Import TOTP hardware tokens from the vendor's PSKC file or a CSV and bind them to users.
edition.Identity assertion grants - Description: Trust identity assertions from other identity providers so agents get tokens for your applications.
edition.Idle timeout - Description: Sessions idle for longer than the set minutes have to sign in again, for the organization or one application.
edition.Legacy system form autofill - Descriptio: The browser extension and the Windows desktop client fill the sign-in pages and windows of legacy systems without SSO, web or client/server, with each user's managed account, with the passwords encrypted and every fill recorded
edition.MCP gateway - Description: Put MCP servers behind Casdoor: agents call tools with Casdoor credentials, including the fixed headers of domestic agent platforms.
edition.MCP tool call records - Description: Every tool call through the gateway is recorded, including the refused ones.
edition.MLPS self-check - Description: Check the settings item by item against MLPS 2.0 level 3 and the cryptography assessment, and print the result.
edition.Masking in the console - Description: Phone numbers, emails and ID card numbers are masked for admins, and viewing the original is recorded.
edition.Mobile one-click login - Description: Apps sign users in with the carrier's number verification, without SMS codes.
edition.More syncers - Description: Run more than one syncer, and sync users from Keycloak.
edition.New location and device alerts - Descrip: Users get an email when their account signs in from a new place or device.
edition.Not in your license - Tip: Your license doesn't include this feature: you can look around, saving it asks for an upgrade
edition.OpenTelemetry tracing - Description: Report a span for each API request and each sign-in step to an OTLP endpoint.
edition.Orphan account cleanup - Description: Find accounts that never signed in, have been idle for long, or are disabled but still hold roles, and disable them in one click.
edition.Paid integrations - Description: Install commercial plugins and templates from the Marketplace: password checks, enterprise push, office systems, Higress and Kong gateway plugins.
edition.Password migration - Description: Users moving from another system sign in with their old passwords, verified by a plugin, then stored in Casdoor.
edition.Push MFA - Description: Users approve a sign-in from a card pushed to WeCom, DingTalk, Lark or another notification channel.
edition.Real-name verification - Description: Verify ID card numbers with names, and phone numbers with their owners, through Tencent Cloud.
edition.Record integrity verification - Descript: Verify the chain to find changed, deleted or inserted records.
edition.Role-based access control - Description: Grant permissions to groups and roles instead of one user at a time.
edition.SM2 certificates - Description: Generate SM2 key pairs and self-signed SM3withSM2 certificates.
edition.SM2 token signing - Description: Sign ID and access tokens with SM2, published in JWKS and the discovery document.
edition.SM3 password hashing - Description: Store passwords with PBKDF2 and HMAC-SM3.
edition.SM4 field encryption - Description: ID card numbers, real names, birthdays and addresses are kept SM4-encrypted in the database, with a key per organization.
edition.SMS limits - Description: Limit SMS per number and per number segment, send to mainland China numbers only, alert and stop at a daily cap.
edition.Security checks on the dashboard - Descr: The dashboard checks MFA, inactive accounts, sessions, passwords and keys across organizations, with the fix one click away.
edition.Security overview and monthly report - D: Sign-in successes and failures, new places and devices, top failed IPs and admin operations, by day or month, printable as a report.
edition.Security score - Description: A score out of 100 across organizations, at the top of the dashboard.
edition.See every feature and take the tour: See every feature and take the tour
edition.Separation-of-duty rules - Description: Refuse giving one user two roles that a rule keeps apart, such as requester and approver.
edition.Signing key rotation - Description: Rotate a certificate's key with one click: new tokens get a new key ID, and the previous public key keeps verifying older tokens.
edition.Tamper-proof audit records - Description: Audit records form an SM3 hash chain and are kept for 6 months at least.
edition.The enterprise edition includes every co: The enterprise edition includes every commercial feature, and adds:

edition.Three-admin separation - Description: System, security and audit admins each do only their own part, as MLPS level 3 asks.
edition.Try it on the %s demo site: Try it on the %s demo site
edition.WeChat member merging - Description: Members created by the website, the official account and the mini program are merged by the WeChat unionid.
edition.Weak and leaked password checks - Descri: Refuse weak passwords, passwords containing the username, and passwords found in known breaches, through Marketplace plugins.
edition.What the commercial and enterprise editi: What the commercial and enterprise editions add, and where each feature is in the console
